hook: A 750B model that thinks like 3 trillion

beats.say: Z.ai's GLM-5.4 is its first flagship built on a Loop Transformer, where a shared block of layers runs more than once per forward pass.
It loops 28 layers of the GLM-5 base model for two iterations, and Z.ai says the result performs like models with two to three trillion parameters.
A hybrid KV cache means the extra loop costs only one sliding window of memory, even at a million tokens. Its weakness: overly long marathon thinking.
